text:
maria: Quick sync request — need to finalize metric names and owners for the per-route SLO dashboards. Scope: latency (p50/p95/p99), TTFT, tokens/sec. Can runtime, telemetry/ingest, and console align on tag schema, sampling, and retention?

kevin: From runtime: we can emit 1s histogram buckets and 1m pre-aggregated rollups. Important: emit p50/p95/p99 as explicit series (don't expect console to compute quantiles client-side). Concern: cardinality explosion if we include model_version + route + customer_id.

jia: Can we agree on exact TTFT and tokens/sec defs? Console and dashboard panels need consistent semantics.

kevin: TTFT = time from request arrival at edge to first token bytes flushed to the client (ms). tokens/sec = total_generated_tokens / effective_generation_time. We'll export per-request values and 1m aggregated series (avg + percentiles).

sam: Cardinality guardrails: required tags: model, route, region, capacity_tier. Optional: model_version (only for 1m rollups), customer_tier (enterprise only). Also add sampling.level for high-card streams.

olivia: Console side: customers want to bind SLOs to route-level metrics (p95 TTFT, p99 latency) and see tokens/sec trends for perf regressions. Need stable metric names and tags so rollouts UI can hook in automatically.

deploy-bot: metrics-collector v3.14 deployed to prod in us-west-2 — now emits 1s histograms and 1m rollups.

kevin: Proposed canonical metric names (please flag objections):

runtime.request.latency.ms.histogram{model,route,region,capacity_tier}
runtime.request.latency.ms.p50{model,route,region,capacity_tier}
runtime.request.latency.ms.p95{model,route,region,capacity_tier}
runtime.request.latency.ms.p99{model,route,region,capacity_tier}
runtime.request.ttft.ms.p50{model,route,region,capacity_tier}
runtime.request.ttft.ms.p95{model,route,region,capacity_tier}
runtime.tokens_per_sec.avg{model,route,region}
runtime.tokens_per_sec.p50{model,route,region}

kevin: We'll also tag sampling.level=full|sampled-1pct|sampled-0.1pct so ingest can drop or route high-card data.

maria: Console needs explicit p50/p95/p99 series (not derived) to avoid heavy dashboards and to support fast alerting.

jia: Retention plan idea: keep 1s rollups for 7d, 1m rollups for 90d. Telemetry ingest will downsample older than 90d to 1h. Agree?

sam: Sounds fine, but ops will post a storage/cost estimate. Also confirm we can blacklist customer_id from high-card exports.

olivia: Rollouts UX: default behavior when new model_version appears should be: show aggregated view across model tag (rollup) and provide a toggle to split by model_version. Need a metadata flag to mark new versions as experimental to auto-hide them unless user opts in.

kevin: We can emit model_version and model_version.experimental=true as a tag at emit-time. For high-card tiers we won't emit model_version at 1s resolution — only on 1m rollups.

maria: Action list (owning teams + target dates):
- runtime (kevin): implement explicit p50/p95/p99 series, sampling.level tag, emit tokens_per_sec avg + p50 at 1m rollup. Due: EOD Tue.
- telemetry/ingest (sam): document retention tiers, sampling behavior, and provide cost estimate. Due: Thu COB.
- console/UX (olivia): wire SLO binding to above metric names, implement default model rollup & model_version toggle in rollouts UX. Due: next Wed.
- platform (jia): validate tag schema against routing metadata and produce a small synthetic dataset for console QA. Due: Fri.

kevin: Example PromQL-ish quick panel queries for tokens/sec and TTFT:

# tokens/sec per-route (1m):
sum by (model,route) (increase(runtime.tokens_generated_total[1m])) /
  sum by (model,route) (increase(runtime.generation_seconds_total[1m]))

# TTFT p95 panel (precomputed series):
avg_over_time(runtime.request.ttft.ms.p95{route=~"^web-.*"}[5m])

jia: We'll use those as starting panels. Also recommend a small histogram widget for TTFT with p50/p95/p99 overlay.

maria: OK — thumbs up if you accept and I'll post this as the formal handoff and schedule a 30m demo of dashboards with synthetic data Friday.

kevin: 👍

sam: :+1:

olivia: :rocket:

maria: Scheduling note: demo Friday 10:00 PT. Locking thread until new changes land.
